scope: Independent static cross-epoch C++ review and exhaustive read-only validation of identified Hayward observations. This JSON is the only file written by the input review.
input_stability: No Python preparation writer was present at this snapshot. Current source/input hashes exactly match the completed exhaustive audit and were rechecked after reading. Initial ray mappings were also rechecked after the path rebasing and rebuild. Selection/run manifests are omitted because the rebuild regenerates them.
checks: All event/origin/pick/arrival tuples map to authoritative normalized picks and corresponding solver events.
Full SEED/FDSN identities and exact numeric receiver coordinates agree on both DD sides.
Each pick falls within its own native half-open UTC metadata epoch; both epoch fields and source hashes match the station rows.
All selected provider arrival weights are known and positive; their exported values match the authoritative records.
Absolute values equal pick time minus retained reference origin time; differences equal the difference of these absolute values.
Picking uncertainties, independent-error differential propagation and 0.05/sigma row multipliers agree with source records.
Absolute data use station_j=-1 and blank second-side identities; cross_metadata_epoch flags agree with native epoch boundaries.
Sparse support equals the native rays supplied by absolute observations; no wrong-epoch j ray is needed.
All saved initial ray-mapping observation/source/receiver metadata fields agree with current inputs, including rebased source paths.
Static C++ review found consistent station_j handling in tracing, prediction, source/model derivative assembly, residual output and diagnostics.

source_review_locations.src/main.cpp:901: Diagnostic i/j and native receiver mapping

assumptions_and_limits: The independent cohort is not identified as the manuscript cohort; waveform-correlation observations are absent.
Exact reported coordinates do not establish survey accuracy; documented borehole and CMW1 elevation interpretations remain assumptions.
Same NSLC and receiver geometry across epochs do not prove unchanged timing calibration. Both epochs and cross_metadata_epoch flags remain available for residual/sensitivity analysis.
Symmetric pick uncertainties are conditionally treated as independent one-standard-deviation noise; confidence levels are absent and shared-pick difference correlations are not whitened.
The existing 5 m nodal path-length-difference cutoff is unchanged; this is not a claim that the thresholded matrix is the unmodified exact full Jacobian.
The pass establishes index, identity, arithmetic and derivative-assembly consistency, not inverse recovery, calibrated uncertainty, complete ray convergence or global optimality.
